say:2:1430113201:0.text: Of course, if you want to be a successful blacksmith, praying to Helthor is important. However, you also need to check your tools.
say:2:1430113201:0.source_cn: 当然，想要锻造成功，除了向赫托祈求，也需要时刻关注随身...

say:3:1430113202:0.text: Hey, my tools are my friends, and they've never let me down before... Wait! Why is there a crack on my hammer?!
say:3:1430113202:0.source_cn: 我相信我的老伙计，它们从来没有出现过问题……等等，我的...

say:5:1430113203:0.text: Because you've always believed in them without taking care of them.
say:5:1430113203:0.source_cn: 因为这么久以来，你一直只是相信它们，却没有好好爱护。
